Name: Iterations
Description: Number of instances the bombing operation will create.

Name: Multiplier
Description: Quickly multiply the instances by increasing or decreasing this value.

Name: Size
Description: The minimum and maximum relative size of bombed instances.

Name: Size Distribution
Description: Uniformity of the size of the bombed instances.

Name: Rotation
Description: The minimum and maximum range of rotations for the bombed instances.

Name: Proportional
Description: Whether instances should maintain height vs size proportion or not.

Name: Height
Description: The minimum and maximum range of height variations for the bombed instances.

Flubs.Name: Random
Flubs.Description: A randomized distribution that results in pure chaotic patterns.

Flubs.Name: Grid
Flubs.Description: A normalized grid distribution function that results in a systematic pattern.

Name: Jitter
Description: The random offset applied to each instance while distributing.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Name: Blend Mode
Description: How the base terrain and bombed instances are merged.

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description: Subtract each instance from the base and previous instances.

Flubs.Name: Difference
Flubs.Description: Create difference between the base and each bombed instance.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: Multiply the base with each bombed instance.

Flubs.Name: Screen
Flubs.Description: Adds the two inputs without overexposing the output.

Flubs.Name: Max
Flubs.Description: Retain the maximum height values of each bombed instance.

Flubs.Name: Min
Flubs.Description: Retain the minimum height values of each bombed instance.

Name: Quality
Description: The level of quality to be used. Draft is recommended when working with high-resolution previews.
